prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original high-end fantasy strategy action game transparent character sprite, a single Ice Bishop from CHECKMATE Frozen Palace.
Primary request: Create an ORIGINAL ice cathedral priest character, not a recolor of any royal or forest bishop. A tall narrow vertically legible silhouette with a clearly split crystalline mitre/crown, long slender ceremonial robes built from layered hard ice panels, a slender frost staff held close to the body, and one small silver reliquary at the chest. Cool grey-blue and silver material, restrained cold sapphire core. Clearly distinguish from a round small soldier, a broad rectangular tower guardian, and an ice horse.
Style/medium: polished hand-painted 3D fantasy game asset, carefully modeled faceted glacial crystal, opaque frosted steel/silver edges, deep slate blue recesses, selective soft icy specular highlights. Not cartoon, not flat vector, not photoreal human portrait. Same coherent material world as a silver-and-blue armored ice soldier and an azure ice tower guardian. Readable primary silhouette before tiny engraving.
Composition/framing: SINGLE isolated full-body character in a weak three-quarter view facing slightly toward screen-left, camera slightly above, restrained perspective. Standing ready, calm dignified pose. Fully visible split crown tips, staff top AND staff ground tip, robe hem AND both boot soles. No pedestal. Body upright and centered, staff near body so silhouette remains slender, both feet around the image center. Generous genuinely empty transparent safety margin at least 8 percent on every edge; whole character fits comfortably. High-resolution portrait composition.
Lighting/mood: upper-left soft key light, darker blue-grey contour on right and lower recesses. Cold noble sacred atmosphere, no background glow.
Color palette: blue-grey outer contour and midtones, pale ice planes, frosted silver, small cold blue core. Enough dark body structure to remain visible on very bright icy chessboard squares; never an all-white ghost. Crown's central split must read even when reduced to about 80 pixels tall. Staff silhouette separate from robe, but not splayed far out.
Scene/backdrop: fully transparent RGBA background. No floor, no scene, no floating particles, no cast ground shadow, no opaque or checkerboard background. Retain naturally antialiased transparent edges.
Constraints: only ONE NEW bishop character, no other chess pieces, no text or numbers, no logo or watermark, no framing border, no cropped extremities. No huge horizontal wings, no oversized spiky cluster, no crown shaped like the King, no horse head, no rook battlements, no forest material. Design for exhibition-quality final game art, not a placeholder.
